The '''Grizmallti''' were the [[Human/Legends|Human]] inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Grizmallt/Legends|Grizmallt]]. They worshipped a [[Deity/Legends|deity]] named [[Nabu]] and were engaged in a [[Grizmallti civil war/Legends|civil war]] around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="Nexus" />

==Behind the scenes==
The inhabitants of Grizmallt were first identified as the Grizmallti in ''[[Nexus of Power]]'', a [[2016]] reference book published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] for the ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[roleplaying game]].<ref name="Nexus" />
